title: feat(app-shell): the design layout menu adds the app's AI inquiry page, and 「Set as home」 moves it first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D3PqTGGb1rgoRqKj4rT4Xjk)_
Fixes #37832
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：应用管理员在「设计布局」里添加菜单项时，多了一种「AI 问询」；填好欢迎标题、副标题、输入框提示和推荐问题即可放进菜单，菜单项的「⋮」里还能再改文案、点「设为首页」把它挪到菜单第一位。
- 为什么做：属于「AI 问询首页」专区，让搭应用的人不进 Studio、不写元数据就能把问询页放进应用并设成首页。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是管理员加了问询页却没成为首页，或文案没生效；保存前能看到菜单，保存后可在设计布局里再移除或挪位，直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/` (the design mode's menu editor):

- **Picker kind 「AI inquiry」.** `MENU_TARGET_KINDS` gains `aiChat`. Like 「Link」 it lists nothing: a small form takes the entry's name (default "Ask AI") and the page's copy, heading / subtitle / question-box hint / suggested questions (one per line). The entry written is `{ id, type: 'component', label, icon: 'sparkles', componentRef: 'ai:chat', params? }` (`entryFor`'s new `aiChat` branch), the shape ui ADR-0057 Amendment A4 decided.
- **Singleton.** `aiChatOffered(menu, served, stored)` hides the kind while the staged menu holds an `ai:chat` entry at any depth, or the stored menu holds one the reader was not shown (the save keeps that one). Removing the shown one in the mode offers the kind again. Until the stored menu is read the kind is not offered. This is the picker's agreement with the spec's `checkAppSingleAiChatEntry`.
- **Form = schema.** `aiChatParamsOf(form)` trims each field, leaves an empty one out (the page then draws its default), takes the non-empty lines as suggestions, and judges the result with `AiChatNavParamsSchema.safeParse`. A refusal is said under its field and the form cannot be sent. Every field empty writes no `params`.
- **The entry's 「⋮」.** 「Edit inquiry page」 opens the same form over the stored copy (`aiChatFormOf`, which fills only from a record the schema takes). 「Set as home」 is `asHome`: `moveEntry(menu, id, null, 0)`, the first place of the top level, and nothing else. No `landing` is written.
- **Save.** Unchanged: `saveAppMenu` writes the app's own package when writable, else its `.custom` pair, and publishes.
- `ui/packages/i18n`: twelve new `designMode.menu.*` strings (one under `kind`) in the eleven locales that carry this block.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/designModeMenuAiChat-37832.test.ts`, one `describe` per acceptance line:

- the entry `entryFor('aiChat', …)` adds is one `AppSchema` takes;
- singleton: offered on an app with none; not offered with one at the top level, nested in a group, or stored but not shown; offered again after the shown one is removed; and the spec refuses the second entry the picker would have added (`navigation.2`);
- the form refuses each bound `AiChatNavParamsSchema` refuses (heading 61, subtitle 201, hint 101, five suggestions, a 101-character suggestion), and the schema refuses the same copy; it takes copy at each bound; all empty writes no `params`;
- 「Set as home」 moves the entry out of its group to the top level's first place, and the save writes the new order with no `landing` key;
- an installed app: the entry is saved into `com.acme.crm.custom`, published there, with no audience keys, and the saved document passes `AppSchema`.

The rendered pins are in the shared harness `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx` (ruling record 6583487846): one new top-level `describe` there. Existing cases are not edited. It pins that the picker offers 「AI inquiry」 on an app with no `ai:chat` entry, adds one through the form and then leaves the kind out; that it leaves the kind out when one is nested in a group; that the entry's 「⋮」 shows 「Edit inquiry page」 and 「Set as home」 while another entry's shows neither; and that 「Set as home」 moves the entry out of its group to the first place and the save writes no `landing`.

Ablations of the singleton rule and of the picker filter: see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- 「Set as home」 only reorders, so on an app that declares `landing` it does not change where those audiences land: a declared `landing` outranks position (ADR-0057 A4 "Home"). The action's copy does not say so; this is kept as a note and the behaviour is unchanged.
- The editor mounts only for an app without `areas` (`UnifiedSidebar`), so `aiChatOffered` reads `navigation`. The spec's rule also counts `areas[].navigation`.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/designModeMenuAiChat-37832.test.ts`. Expect every test to pass. Or, in the console, open 「Design layout」 on an app with no AI inquiry page and click 「Add menu item」. The kinds list 「AI inquiry」. Add one and the kind is gone from the next picker.

Read first, ordered by risk:
1. `designModeMenuModel.ts`: `aiChatOffered` (the stored-but-not-shown branch).
2. `DesignModeMenu.tsx`: `AiChatCopyForm` (validation and the disabled submit).
3. `designModeMenuModel.ts`: `aiChatParamsOf` (the trimming and empty-field rules).

Readings at head `2943fb41` (objectstack-ai/objectstack, merge base `ff63b02b4`), for the harness pins this head adds; the readings for `0d1358c7` follow.
